events.title: Industrial Detroit - The Treasury, Hexx Head, Mission to the Sun, Deadlines
events.description:
The Treasury is the Richmond based project of Troy Hancock. With a sound rooted in industrial and EBM, The Treasury brings punk elements creating a fresh take on darkwave. Following their 2025 release on DKA Records, The Treasury has toured extensively and become known for a hard hitting live set.

Hexx Head is the collaboration of artists Allie Coppola and Mike Frazier. The Boston-based electronic duo is known for blending industrial, EBM, and noise. Since their debut release, Seabeds Cough, they’ve toured from east to west coast, delivering off-kilter rhythms fused with dance music’s beat-forward structure. 

Mission to the Sun is a Detroit based project of Kirill and C.M. Samuels ( Ritual Howls ). All new set of beat driven material at this show. 

DJ Deadlines on the decks, holding it down before and in-between bands

events.description: GED: Ghettotech Electro Drum'n'Bass is back with3 local DJs/hardware musicians playing these genres.  Using these shows to organize around these genres in the Washtenaw County Area - monthly shows focused on one or two genres (and adjacent). We want to hear everyone's voice on how said shows should look like.  Venue is a cannabis lounge 1 block of main street downtown Ann Arbor.  Dancing and visuals.  BYOB.
